lines.text: Claude can now automatically copy the trades of Wall Street insiders, and you can set this entire thing up inside Claude.
First, connect LiquidTrade, which lets Claude interact with stocks, crypto, forex, and even prediction markets.
This gives Claude access to data showing what insiders and politicians and even major investors are actually buying and selling.
Now here's where it gets crazy.
You can create a routine that has Claude automatically check those trades throughout the day, compare them against your portfolio, and find any new positions worth looking at.
When it finds one, Claude can send you the trade, explain what happened, and ask for your approval.
Approve it, and Claude can execute the trade through LiquidTrade for you.
So you're basically turned Claude into a trading agent that can research, monitor, and execute from one place.
Comment signal, and I'll send you my full video showing you exactly how to build it.
